verdict.rationale: Ollama's own docs show it working as a coding-agent backend. The `ollama launch` command sets up and runs Claude Code, OpenCode and Codex against local or cloud models with no config, and Ollama exposes Anthropic Messages API compatibility, OpenAI-compatible endpoints and a REST API. The GitHub README separately lists connecting Claude Code, OpenCode, Codex and Copilot. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on community corroboration of coding-agent backend use, and full rather than subset OpenAI API compatibility.
